Remark
[The limiting canonical neighborhood is a cap, not a strong epsilon-neck] ↗ lem:limit-canonical-neighborhood-fails-at-surgery-scale

When the limiting strong-neck embedding meets a surgery cap, the canonical neighborhood obtained for the approximating points is a $(C,\epsilon )$-cap coming from the cap evolution, not a strong $\epsilon $-neck.
